notes.text: USJ hours for 22 Dec aren't published yet: check the official calendar the week before and set the alarm from the opening time.
Original passports (bars and karaoke at night), phones charged, USJ and Jankara apps installed and logged in.
December cold all day and dark well before the evening show; wear layers, gloves and shoes you can stand in all day.

stops.summary: USJ's 25th-anniversary winter: rope-drop to Super Nintendo World, then Christmas lights after dark.
stops.story: It's the 25th-anniversary Universal Holiday Wonders season, running 13 Nov 2026 to 17 Jan 2027, and you're here on a quiet Tuesday before the Christmas Eve price jump and crowds. After dark, Gramercy Park gets the new 'Light Up the Night ~Christmas Celebration~' show and Joy of Lights is back after 9 years. The Universal Food Festival is the park's biggest yet, so lunch and dinner sort themselves out.
how: Be at the gate 45 min before opening and walk straight to Super Nintendo World.
No Express? Grab the free timed-entry ticket for Super Nintendo World in the app the moment you're in.
Use your Express slots for Mario Kart and Harry Potter; eat lunch and an early dinner at the Universal Food Festival.
Catch the 17:30 night show in Gramercy Park and Joy of Lights, then leave: the train out of Universal City is at 19:24.
tips: Buy all 8 in one order so your Express Pass ride times line up.
Only Express Pass 5 and Pass 7 include Mario Kart; Pass 4 doesn't.
The Joy of Lights viewing area is a separate ticket from ¥1,700 on top of park admission; the show itself is visible without it.
stops.cost: Studio Pass ~¥9,900–11,900 pp (dynamic, dated) + Express Pass from ~¥14,800 pp; show viewing area from ¥1,700
stops.booking: Buy dated tickets and Express Passes now on the official USJ web store; Express sells out.
stops.hours: Varies by day (check the USJ calendar)
wishes: We love to do it all
We want to maximise all the time we've got in the country
Look for money we can save by booking early or buying passes

stops.summary: First Osaka bite of the night: crisp, molten takoyaki and the osenbei rice-cracker sandwich.
stops.story: Wanaka's flagship on Sennichimae is the safe bet for great takoyaki in Minami: crisp shells, molten centres, steam you can see in the cold night air. The move is the 'osenbei' — takoyaki pressed between a big rice cracker, a crunchy hand-held you can only really get in Osaka.
how: Come straight from Namba station; it may close at 21:00.
Order a box or two to share plus a couple of osenbei sandwiches.
Eat at the seats or by the takeaway window, then walk 6 min north to Hozenji.
tips: Listings disagree on closing time (21:00 or 23:00), so don't leave it for later in the night.
Let them cool a minute: the inside is properly molten.
wishes: We love to do it all

stops.summary: Splash the moss-furred Fudo statue, then first drinks in Osaka's lantern-lit stone lane.
stops.story: One minute from Dotonbori's neon, Hozenji Yokocho goes quiet: a narrow flagstone alley of paper lanterns and about a dozen tiny izakaya and bars. At its heart, Fudo Myoo is so coated in moss from people splashing water on him that he looks green and furry. On a cold December night the lanterns and steamy windows make it feel like old Osaka.
how: Ladle water over the Fudo statue and make a wish.
Split into twos and fours: most places only seat 4–6.
One or two drinks each, then regroup at the statue and walk 1 min to Jankara.
tips: Expect a seat charge (otoshi) of ¥300–500 with a small dish.
Lanterns are lit for the photos until about 21:00.

stops.summary: Close the night at Osaka's own karaoke chain: all-you-can-drink BAL UTAO or one big room for all of you.
stops.story: Jankara is Osaka's homegrown cheap karaoke chain, and this Dotonbori flagship is its biggest: 51 rooms on B1–5F, open 24 hours. BAL UTAO is its all-you-can-drink karaoke lounge, a livelier and cheaper night than Round1 karaoke.
how: Reception is on 1F; ask for BAL UTAO or a room for 4 to 14 people.
Show the Jankara app to get the member rate, and order 1 food item each.
Leave by 23:05 for the 23:22 Hanshin Namba line from Osaka-Namba to Kujō (¥220).
tips: Join the free Jankara app before you go: BAL UTAO drops from ¥1,000 to ¥500 per 30 min.
Rooms can be booked online through すぐカラ.
Don't stay late: alcohol stops at 00:00 and tomorrow is an early Kyoto start.
stops.cost: BAL UTAO ¥500 per 30 min with the app (¥1,000 without) + 1 food item each
stops.booking: Download the Jankara app; rooms bookable online
